info.name: I racconti di Olaf
info.plot: Olaf dà spettacolo, con le sue rivisitazioni uniche di cinque classici della Disney Animation.

info.title: I racconti di Olaf
info.synopsis: Olaf dà spettacolo, con le sue rivisitazioni uniche di cinque classici della Disney Animation.

episodes.name: The Little Mermaid
episodes.plot: Olaf gets into the swim of things in this delightful retelling of the 1989 Disney Animation musical favorite, “The Little Mermaid,” taking on such diverse roles as Ariel, Triton, Scuttle, and Chef Louis, among others.

translations.value: Olaf gets into the swim of things in this delightful retelling of the 1989 Disney Animation musical favorite, “The Little Mermaid,” taking on such diverse roles as Ariel, Triton, Scuttle, and Chef Louis, among others.

episodes.name: Moana
episodes.plot: Olaf’s retelling of the Oscar®-nominated Disney Animation feature “Moana” finds the versatile snowman appearing as the title character of Moana, the shapeshifting demigod Maui, Heihei the rooster, and the treasure-loving coconut crab Tamatoa, among others.

translations.value: Olaf’s retelling of the Oscar®-nominated Disney Animation feature “Moana” finds the versatile snowman appearing as the title character of Moana, the shapeshifting demigod Maui, Heihei the rooster, and the treasure-loving coconut crab Tamatoa, among others.

episodes.name: The Lion King
episodes.plot: Olaf takes pride in presenting a very different look at the Pride Lands from this 1994 Disney Animation classic, “The Lion King,” and starring in a variety of roles from Simba and Mufasa to both Pumbaa and Timon.

translations.value: Olaf takes pride in presenting a very different look at the Pride Lands from this 1994 Disney Animation classic, “The Lion King,” and starring in a variety of roles from Simba and Mufasa to both Pumbaa and Timon.

episodes.name: Aladdin
episodes.plot: Olaf shows viewers a “whole new world” as he takes on the starring role of the “street rat”-turned-Prince/title character, Aladdin, in this unique retelling of the 1992 Walt Disney Animation Studios musical fantasy.

translations.value: Olaf shows viewers a “whole new world” as he takes on the starring role of the “street rat”-turned-Prince/title character, Aladdin, in this unique retelling of the 1992 Walt Disney Animation Studios musical fantasy.

episodes.name: Tangled
episodes.plot: Olaf lets down his hair for this towering and imaginative retelling of the 2010 Disney Animation favorite, “Tangled,” and even portrays Rapunzel along with other key characters.

translations.value: Olaf lets down his hair for this towering and imaginative retelling of the 2010 Disney Animation favorite, “Tangled,” and even portrays Rapunzel along with other key characters.

episodes.name: Compilation
episodes.plot: See all five Olaf Presents shorts back to back.

translations.value: See all five Olaf Presents shorts back to back.
